name: Everyday Life
description: A collection of relatable and funny moments from daily life

items.prompt_text: When your alarm goes off and you realize you only closed your eyes for 5 minutes
Accidentally sent a screenshot of the chat to the exact person you're gossiping about
Going to the grocery store for milk and leaving with $150 worth of random snacks
When the barber turns the mirror, asks 'how does it look?', and you say 'perfect' while dying inside
Remembering an embarrassing moment from middle school at 3:00 AM
Opening the fridge for the 8th time expecting gourmet food to magically spawn
When the waiter says 'Enjoy your meal!' and you reply 'You too!'
When your friend texts 'I'm 2 mins away' but you can hear the shower running in the background
Trying to open a bag of chips at 2 AM without alerting the entire universe
Seeing someone you know in public and suddenly finding your shoes fascinating
Setting 10 alarms 5 minutes apart and still waking up 2 hours late
When someone asks about your dating life and you don't even have a sleep schedule
When your cat stares intensely into an empty dark corner like it sees a ghost
Lying down for a 'quick 20-minute nap' and waking up in another dimension
Trying on clothes you love until you check the price tag
Telling a joke in a group and being greeted with dead silence
Finishing all the dishes, turning around, and seeing a dirty frying pan on the stove
Standing in the checkout line alone while your mom went to grab 'one quick thing'
Trying to remember if you locked the front door when you're already 10 miles away
Wearing brand new white shoes right before a sudden thunderstorm
Telling the waiter the food was great even though you hated every bite
Trying to physically get out of bed on a cold Monday morning
When your grandma insists you look starving and serves a 4th plate of food
Using your phone's flashlight to search the dark house for your lost phone
Walking into a room with confidence and instantly forgetting why you went there
Checking your bank account on Monday morning after a wild weekend
When your upstairs neighbor decides Sunday 7:00 AM is the prime time for bowling
Deciding to completely change your life at 2:00 AM on a random Tuesday
Dropping your phone and watching it land screen-down on concrete
When you wave back at someone who was actually waving to the person behind you
